gen.title: Drag dependencies and the drag equation

cards.stem: Which statement correctly describes a dependence of drag mentioned in the passage?
options: Drag depends on the density of the air
The mass of the fuel load
The colour of the aircraft paint
The pilot name on the manifest
cards.quote: Drag depends on the density of the air, the square of the velocity, the air’s viscosity and compressibility, the size and shape of the body
cards.hint: Think about properties of the surrounding air.

cards.stem: What does the passage call the single variable that collects complex drag effects?
options: For drag, this variable is called the drag coefficient
The maximum speed of the aircraft
The colour of the runway lights
The weight of the cargo hold
cards.quote: For drag, this variable is called the drag coefficient, designated “Cd.”
cards.hint: Look for the name given to the single variable.

cards.stem: Which type of drag is listed as part of the drag coefficient?
options: The drag coefficient given above includes form drag
Ram drag counted with net thrust
Engine noise in the cabin
Pilot skill rating
cards.quote: The drag coefficient given above includes form drag, skin friction drag, wave drag, and induced drag components.
cards.hint: Check which drag types are bundled together.

cards.stem: How are drag coefficients normally obtained?
options: Drag coefficients are almost always determined experimentally
They are guessed from colour charts
They are set by pilot preference only
They are copied from a textbook table
cards.quote: Drag coefficients are almost always determined experimentally using a wind tunnel.
